project_info.theme: Immersive warm-light auburn freckled beauty close-up
project_info.color_palette: copper, bronze, pale warm skin, amber, deep black, dark brown

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with thick wavy auburn-copper hair, pale skin with pink warm undertones, prominent natural freckles across her nose and cheeks, beauty marks on her neck and left forearm, blue-green almond eyes, thick brushed-up reddish-brown brows, a slightly upturned button nose, and full natural rose lips with clear gloss. She wears a black sleeveless top, silver rings with inset stones, a delicate tennis bracelet, a wide crystal-set ring, and a black leather-strap watch.
main_subject.style: photorealistic cinematic warm-tungsten beauty portrait with natural skin texture

items: eye-level close-up, sharp focus on the eyes with soft falloff over hands and hair
right hand curled against the cheek and left hand resting under the chin and neck
loose voluminous side-parted hair forms a golden backlit halo
a blurred warm lampshade appears in the lower-right background
dark warm-brown, amber, and deep-black indoor setting

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cinematic warm tungsten key from front-left, negative fill on the right, and a subtle back hair light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Rembrandt-style facial contrast, warm highlights on curls, deep controlled shadows, and softly bloomed highlights

technical_specs.render_style: Sony A7R IV or Canon R5 with an 85mm f/1.2 prime and Tiffen Glimmerglass 1
technical_specs.color_treatment: golden-hour warmth with slightly desaturated shadows, visible pores, freckles, and natural tone variation

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an eye-level 3:4 cinematic warm-tungsten close-up of an adult woman with thick, wavy, slightly frizzy auburn-copper hair, pale warm-toned skin, prominent natural freckles across her nose and cheeks, beauty marks on her neck and left forearm, piercing blue-green almond eyes, brushed-up reddish-brown brows, a slightly upturned button nose, and full natural rose lips with clear gloss. She wears a black sleeveless top, layered silver rings, a delicate tennis bracelet, a wide crystal-set ring, and a black leather-strap watch. Frame her hands around her face: the right hand curled at her cheek and the left hand under chin and neck. Use heavy shimmering copper-bronze eyeshadow, mascara, natural blush, and a dewy but real skin finish. Place her in a dim warm-brown and amber interior with a blurred lamp in the lower right. Light with a warm front-left tungsten key, negative fill on the right, and a subtle hair light for a golden halo and Rembrandt-style contrast. Sony A7R IV or Canon R5, 85mm f/1.2, Tiffen Glimmerglass 1, sharp eyes, soft falloff, golden warmth, slightly desaturated shadows, realistic pores and freckles.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, jewelry, or lighting references may be attached. Preserve the adult identity, auburn hair, freckles and beauty marks, hand placement, jewelry arrangement, black sleeveless top, and warm tungsten lighting when those references are supplied.
